name: LinkedIn Desk
tagline: Vets LinkedIn invitations daily against a policy you set
description: Filters pitches and spam, recommends accept or ignore, and clicks nothing you have not approved. First-run setup is required before it touches LinkedIn at all.

source.excerpt: Shared as an invitation filter that recommends rather than acts.

body:
## What it does

Filters pitches and spam, recommends accept or ignore, and clicks nothing you have not approved. First-run setup is required before it touches LinkedIn at all. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @SEO shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
